evals.prompt: I run a fitness coaching business called "Iron Mindset" — I work with busy professionals who want to get strong, lose fat, and build discipline without spending 2 hours at the gym every day. My programs are 45-minute sessions, 4x a week, fully online. I charge $297/month for group coaching and $697/month for 1-on-1. Make me a landing page.
evals.expected_output: A single standalone HTML file with a complete neumorphic landing page for Iron Mindset fitness coaching. Should have: neumorphic shadow system (#e6e9ef base, dual shadows), red/orange accent color (fitness category), Outfit+Inter fonts, GSAP animations, hero with animated blobs, stats section with data-count, features grid, pricing cards (group $297 + 1-on-1 $697), FAQ accordion, all sections S1-S8 at minimum. Must use hosted images (Aura James CDN or Unsplash). No broken local paths. Single .html file.
assertions: Output is a single HTML file
CSS defines .neu-raised class with dual box-shadow
CSS defines .btn-primary with gradient and convex shadow
Accent color is red/orange/warm (fitness category: #ef4444 or similar)
Google Fonts link for Outfit and Inter is present in head
GSAP and ScrollTrigger CDN scripts are included
All GSAP code is inside window.addEventListener DOMContentLoaded
Hero section has animated blob elements
Stats section has at least one [data-count] element
Pricing section includes $297 and $697 price points
FAQ uses GSAP accordion (maxHeight animation), not CSS transition
Marquee uses CSS @keyframes marquee, not Tailwind animate-marquee
All image src attributes use https:// URLs (no local paths or placeholders)
Title tag contains Iron Mindset or similar business name
